listing.name: Navarchy of Tania
listing.summary: Adds a new faction focused on resilient, mobile ships and unique campaign mechanics including personal storage and classified missions.

description:
Hosted on Github since July 29th, 2026

A nation forged in despair and war, that survived the Luddic Church mayhem. The Navarchy of Tania succeeds on fast paced combat, constantly changing positions and pushing enemies from multiple directions. Its ships specialize in resilience over firepower, often demonstrating survivability prowess on the battlefield, sporting strong armor, efficient (but narrow) shield emitters and astonishing mobility. Victory is assured by outliving the enemies, using their own mistakes against themselves.

Learn More

Campaign Features:

Spoiler

Unique submarkets:

Spoiler

Tired of relying on abandoned stations to store your items? Worry no more! With Navarchy of Tania's enlistment program (commission), you now have Personal Storages on civilian markets! No fees, all for free! If you complete your missions, you won't even have to worry with enlisting to have access to them.

Navarchy of Tania does not have standard military markets. Instead, there is a proper Internal Market for trusted captains. At start, prices may be harsh, but gaining reputation will grant discounts on tariffs. Buying too much of a commodity there may generate deficit on the colony, as it is provided directly from its production line.

"In disruption, there is opportunity". After the mayhem of cycle 181 and 182, a mafia under the shadows was born, growing up in such a scale that every business dealt there is veiled. The Suburban Legion welcomes anyone bold enough to gain their trust. To access it, you must become hostile to either Hegemony or Luddic Church and keep it like that. It will also sell special ships after completing certain missions.

If you know the story, you may think that it would be impossible to find blueprints from those ships out of their own facilities, which is true. But that doesn't mean that you won't have access to them eventually. The Classified Hall presents the opportunity to learn them, but such confidential information is only accessible to very important representatives, which means that you must become cooperative with the Navarchy in order to negotiate.[close]

Campaign Missions:

Spoiler

Earning reputation with the Navarchy of Tania grants you access to classified missions, with high level tasks to be completed. Those offer prizes which can vary depending on your choices, credits will be the least optimal reward you will get here. Make sure to prepare yourself with the best you got, the prizes matches the risk.

Check this video bellow introducing one of them:

[close]

Starsystem Location:

Spoiler

The Navarchy of Tania is located at Carina, a starsystem situated at the galactic south of the Core Worlds, near Eos Exodus and Penelope's Star. It contains a rather small amount of planets within, including Tania, Farige and Calypso, with Volans as the latter's moon. Due to a dense nebula surrounding the system, two Siphon Stations were placed to synthetize antimatter fuel.[close][close]

Requirements/Compatibilities:

Spoiler

- This mod requires Lazylib and Magiclib to work properly;

- This mod is compatible with Nexerelin. All features present in Normal Core Worlds will also function in Random Core Worlds, including submarkets and missions.

- This mod can be added mid-save, its starsystem will promptly spawn after loading. Although it will require time to respawn if Random Core Worlds is active.

[close]

FAQs:

Spoiler

Is this mod balanced?

I did my best to keep it fun to use while fair to fight against, by testing and balancing in comparison to the base game (vanilla), including late game power scaling. I also got help from other testers like lChronosl, Gen Waffle and Duckie0012. I also have practice fighting against powerful and sometimes unbalanced compositions using a vanilla only Falcon Spam fleet (check out my Youtube channel for the videos!), and I used those lessons when creating and balancing the Navarchy of Tania ships and weapons.

Is this mod demanding on the hardware?

I did my best to keep its load on check, as I very much appreciate high and stable FPS gameplay and was frequently irritated when playing against overdone graphics that ate through my frames like an Invictus with 4 Mjolnirs firing ahoy. Visuals are handled by Magiclib and Lazylib instead.

How do those modules work?

Navarchy of Tania ships (except the Gralha) have modular armor plates that can be refitted in various ways. They can, for example, enhance the parent ship's flux grid with extra vents and capacitors, have extra durability with Heavy Armor and Reinforced Bulkheads and even can become fighter bays themselves via Converted Hangar hullmod. Albeit they can't have smods.

Are there any story quests?

Yes. Missions can be unlocked by increasing your relationship with the Navarchy of Tania faction. Upon reaching higher relations, Navarchon Gabriel Ferrera will send you intel about available Classified Missions. Be aware though that you must have a strong late game fleet to deal with your foes, so plan ahead before engaging them. You can also donate a small amount of credits to a beacon located at Vela Jump Point, someone may thank you and gladly present you to the faction! You don't need to be Comissioned to the Navarchy to do these quests. And as a small spoiler, they have different rewards depending on your choices.

Are there custom bounties?

Not yet, as I focused efforts on consolidate the faction before extra content, but expect to see bounties soon!

Is there any hidden content?

If its hidden, it cannot be spoiled! But if you want a tip, make sure to explore Carina for a while, you may find something interesting!

Do you have plans for future content?

Yes, albeit slowly. I tend to go for quality rather than speed/quantity, but be sure that each update will bring my best work![close]

Changelog (Before 1.2.0):

Spoiler

Disclaimer: from 1.2.0 onwards, changelogs are now handled in separated files, this log is only for historic preservation. 1.2.0 is not compatible with the previous versions below:

1.1.0 - Update: GUNS! GLORIOUS GUNS!

- As the name suggests, added several guns for Navarchy of Tania to use:

Small:

* Sirius Gatling Gun

* Osório Support Gun

* Bison Torpedo Launcher

* Thorn Cannon

* Agulha Defense System

* Carbonite Jetstream

* Boomerang MRM Launcher

* Fafnir HV Cannon

Large:

* Fafnir HV Artillery

* The Nidhogg

* Bison Torpedo Pod

* Garra Autocannon

* Acid Howitzer

Ship Changes:

- Aracari:

* Large weapon slot is now composite (was ballistic);

' No Navarchy of Tania ship had large missile slots until now, and Aracari seems to be the perfect host for this, as a 40 DP cruiser that is designed to be a "marvel". Flexibility should be its core goal anyways, so the catch here is adding another refit option. You can go full guns and use the most of its Solaris Phalanx ship system, or go for a missile oriented build, with its large missile weapon being supplied by a Missile Autoforge, your choice!

- Battlecruiser package:

* Set Missile Autoforge cooldown to 30 seconds (was a period between 10 and 15 seconds);

* Added special enhancement for Boomerang SRM Launcher in combination with this hullmod;

* Speed penalty for installing Converted Hangar on modules is now reduced to capital ship levels;

* Improved description readability.

- Aetos:

* Improved Visuals;

* Added Thermal Calibration hullmod: reduces large ballistic weapons base range by 15%;

* Reverted max speed to 80 (was reduced to 60 in the last patch).

- Touraco:

* Increased max speed to 80 (was 70).

- Black Hawk:

* Increased max speed to 55 (was 50).

!!! Variants now use new weapons provided by this update;

!!! Adjusted flux stats for modules, so point defenses can be used properly;

!!! Optimized graphics, so less particles are used by ship systems, improving hardware performance;

!!! Improved ship AI, so vessels no longer will be as reckless as before (Onslaught Mk.1 be damned).

Hullmod Changes:

- Navarchy Armor Plate:

* Speed penalty for installing Converted Hangar is now 30/15/5. (was 20/10/5 before);

* Improved description readability.

- Ancient Weapon Systems:

* Shield damage penalty removed (a lot of people asked for this);

* Reduced RoF penalty to 10% (was 15%);

* Reduced weapon damage bonus to 10% (was 15%);

* Reduced damage and hit strength vs hull/armor bonus to 10% (was 20%).

!!! Several people complained about Remnants, Shroud and other high tech factions being awful to deal with due to low DPS against shields. However, in order to keep things fair, I also reduced efficiency against armor, so it does not become an overtuned hullmod.

* Reduced weapon turn rate and damage vs fighters/missiles debuff to 25% (was 50%).

' Navarchy of Tania's weapons layout already don't favor point defense countermeasures due to low amounts of weaponry. They are being brutalized by Mine Strikes and Persean League's DEMs, which really undermines their capability as a faction and forces people to rely on point defense fighters to deal with that, which is not ideal.

Extras:

* Fixed (again) Siphon Fuel Industry being able to be built by the player;

* Reduced blueprint and ship costs at Classified Hall submarket;

!!! New weapon blueprints appearing at Classified Hall will require a new save, but otherwise, this update is save compatible (make sure to do backups though).

1.0.2 - Update: Adjustments for 1.0.1 and a lil bug fix. Save compatible, but always do a backup!

Disclaimer: I no longer will put notes explaining the changes, as I received feedback that people not read those to begin with. That being said, it will be easier for me to do and also will be more direct to the point for who wish to only know the stats and nothing else.

Balance changes:

- Argentavis:

* Removed Flare Launchers from modules and reduced their hitpoints to 4000 (was 5000);

* Reduced main hull hitpoints to 6000 (was 7000).

- Touraco:

* Removed Flare Launchers from modules;

* Increased Deployment Points to 30 (was 28).

- Aetos:

* Decreased max speed to 60 (was 80);

* Thermo-Accelerator ship system: Flux cost reduction to fire weapons was tuned down to 33% (was 66%).

- Sandgrouse:

* Reverted Deployment Points to its original 4 (was 3 in the last patch);

* Decreased flux capacity to 3000 (was 4500);

* Shield efficiency is now 0.7 (was 0.65);

- Gralha:

* Decreased max speed to 150 (was 165);

* Improved Point Defense Core: Decreased point defense range bonus to 100 (was 200).

- All Ships:
